style.toneOfVoice: Make a statement this winter with this stunning, everlasting wreath that s lovingly hand crafted and decked with natural pinecones for a truly luxurious affair. The traditional wreath is effortlessly festive. Decorated with natural materials for a long-lasting decoration, with plump red berries and bundles of cinnamon sticks. The forest foraged pinecones are carefully stained in rich red and green tones for a classic colour palette that will complement any home with ease, whether rustic or contemporary. Complete with a jute hanging rope, so you can display this generously sized wreath in pride of place on your front door, or above the mantelpiece of a roaring fireplace to give your home a warm and welcoming feeling. Dia. 38cm Size: ONE.
